verdict.rationale: Superset ships agent-oriented docs on several surfaces. Probes confirm a live docs llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a product llms.txt that indexes the whole machine surface, including scoped llms.txt files for docs/api/blog/compare and agents.md. Per-page llms.mdx docs and a published agents.md give agents direct entry points, and hands-on runtime probes corroborate the vendor claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.superset.sh/llms.txt # Superset Documentation
keyless GET of https://superset.sh/llms.txt returned the product llms.txt (text/plain)
agents.md, and scoped llms.txt files for docs/api/blog/compare
Each agent gets an isolated Git worktree and its own branch.
